description: Score a transaction against an Omniguard function (allow / review / block) — test the business-logic rules end to end. Defaults to a dry_run (evaluates rules, no metering/persistence). Needs the Omniguard ingest token and function_id from nemesis_create_omniguard. Pass the risk signals the rules check (amount, country vs card_country, card_type, cvv_result, three_ds_status, is_new_device, decline_count).

functionId.description: The Omniguard function id to score against

live.description: true = score for real (meters against quota). Default false = dry_run test.

name: nemesis_omniguard_score
